papers.name: Component 01 Business 1: business activity, marketing and people

topics.name: 1 Business activity
points: 1.1 The role of business enterprise and entrepreneurship: characteristics of entrepreneurs, risk and reward
1.2 Business planning: purpose and usefulness of a business plan
1.3 Business ownership: sole traders, partnerships, private and public limited companies; limited liability
1.4 Business aims and objectives and why they change and differ
1.5 Stakeholders in business: roles, objectives and effects on business
1.6 Business growth: organic growth
1.6 Business growth: external growth (mergers and takeovers: horizontal, vertical, diversification)

topics.name: 2 Marketing
points: 2.1 The role of marketing
2.2 Market research: purpose, primary and secondary research methods
2.2 Qualitative and quantitative data
2.3 Market segmentation: age, gender, income, location and lifestyle
2.4 Product: product life cycle, design, invention and innovation
2.4 Price: skimming, cost-plus, penetration, competitor-based and promotional pricing
2.4 Promotion: point of sale and advertising methods
2.4 Place: digital and physical distribution channels
2.4 Using the marketing mix together; interpreting market data

topics.name: 3 People
points: 3.1 The role of human resources
3.2 Organisational structures: tall and flat, span of control, chain of command, delegation
3.2 Ways of working: full-time, part-time, flexible, temporary, home and mobile working, self-employment
3.3 Communication in business: methods, importance and influence of digital communication
3.4 Recruitment and selection: reasons, internal and external methods, job descriptions and person specifications
3.4 Selection methods: CVs, application forms, interviews, tests and references
3.5 Motivation and retention: financial and non-financial methods
3.6 Training and development: induction, on-the-job and off-the-job training; staff development
3.7 Employment law: discrimination, contracts, holidays and working hours

papers.name: Component 02 Business 2: operations, finance and influences on business

topics.name: 4 Operations
points: 4.1 Production processes: job, batch and flow production; automation and robotics
4.2 Quality of goods and services: quality control and quality assurance
4.3 The sales process and customer service
4.4 Consumer law
4.5 Business location
4.6 Working with suppliers: procurement, logistics and supply decisions

topics.name: 5 Finance
points: 5.1 The role of the finance function
5.2 Sources of finance: reasons for finance and sources for new and established businesses
5.3 Revenue, fixed, variable and total costs
5.3 Gross and net profit and profit margins
5.3 Average rate of return
5.4 Break-even: calculation and usefulness
5.5 Cash and cash flow: liquidity, cash versus profit, cash flow forecasts

topics.name: 6 Influences on business
points: 6.1 Ethical considerations: treatment of workers, suppliers and customers; sourcing; marketing
6.1 Environmental considerations: sustainability, waste, pollution and climate change
6.2 The economic climate: consumer income and unemployment
6.3 Globalisation: multinationals, location, international branding and competition

topics.name: 7 The interdependent nature of business
points: Interdependence of operations, finance, marketing and human resources
How interdependencies underpin business decision making
The impact of risk and reward on business activity
Using financial information to measure business performance and inform decisions
